_comment: vtracer tuning presets. png2svg.py already wires up --preset <name> and --list-presets; --n-colors / --scale can also override a single run's parameters.

apple-precise._description: Flat cartoon / rounded bumps / soft-rubber-texture character (clouds, marshmallows, refined-rounded style)

pixel-art._description: Full-pixel character (FC / GBA style). mode polygon preserves right angles, filter_speckle 0 keeps every pixel

high-detail._description: Complex illustration / many colors / lots of gradients. Use with caution — the SVG route itself isn't good at this, consider the APNG route
